Fit a tank-replicated functional treatment contrast with cluster bands

Source: R/functional-event-tanks.R
aqt_functional_tank_contrast.Rd

A per-tank mean fish curve is computed FIRST, so each independent tank contributes one curve regardless of fish number or video frame rate. Tanks are then resampled WITHIN treatment arms. The simultaneous max-deviation band is an empirical tank-resampling sensitivity band; coverage is NOT certified by this method, and it does not include camera/identity measurement uncertainty or establish causality. All tanks must cover every requested time; use min_fish_fraction=1 (default) to forbid changing observed fish composition at grid points.

Usage

aqt_functional_tank_contrast(
  grid,
  treatment_levels = c("control", "treatment"),
  min_fish_fraction = 1,
  draws = 499L,
  level = 0.95,
  seed = 1L
)

Arguments

grid

Output of aqt_functional_event_grid containing tank and treatment.

treatment_levels

Exactly control,treatment labels.

min_fish_fraction

Required supported fish fraction at each tank/time.

draws

Number of within-arm independent-tank resamples, >=100.

level

Central percentile mass.

seed

Integer R seed, caller global RNG state preserved.

Value

Per-tank means, time-varying contrasts, pointwise/simultaneous uncalibrated resampling bands, design audit and caveats.
